jobs.name: Airplane Window
jobs.prompt: 16-bit pixel art, SNES game style, visible pixels, no smoothing. Vertical story format. Game title 'DOG TRAVEL' in bold pixel font at top with lime #baf122 glow. Subtitle 'by Hack Your Way' below. Golden retriever and cream-white border collie looking out of airplane window, noses pressed against glass, amazed expressions. View through oval airplane window shows fluffy clouds below and sunrise above clouds. Wing of plane visible. Interior airplane seats, overhead bins. Dogs wearing tiny travel pillows around necks. Color palette: lime #baf122, red #ff3131 sunrise, purple #5e17eb sky gradient. Excited travel mood, 9:16 vertical.
